import os,json,pathlib
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace/validation')
leaks=[]
for p in root.rglob('*'):
 if p.is_file():
  data=p.read_bytes()
  for key in ['MCP_SERVER_TOKEN','MCPJAM_API_KEY']:
   val=os.environ.get(key,'')
   if val and val.encode() in data: leaks.append(str(p))
print('Credential value matches:',len(leaks))
print('Files preserved:',sum(p.is_file() for p in root.rglob('*')))
checks=json.load(open(root/'tool-checks.json'))
print('Tool checks:',sum(x['passed'] for x in checks),'/',len(checks))
print('Report:',(root/'REPORT.md').exists(),'Reproducer:',(root/'reproduce.sh').exists())
